policyEngine.description: Admission-policy engine: 'kyverno' renders the framework ClusterPolicies, 'external' renders none. No default — you must declare one.

authEngine.description: Apiserver identity engine: 'oidc' renders StructuredAuthenticationConfiguration from the idps blocks, 'external' renders none (operator wired apiserver auth outside the framework, e.g. AKS Entra ID / GKE federation). No default — you must declare one.

idps.description: Per-IdP trust blocks rendered into the apiserver AuthenticationConfiguration under authEngine=oidc. One block per issuer; multiple blocks are permitted (multi-issuer).

issuer.description: OIDC issuer URL. The apiserver fetches JWKS from this issuer's Discovery endpoint at runtime.

audience.description: Mandatory per-IdP aud value. A block without an audience is invalid.

certificateAuthority.description: Optional PEM CA bundle the apiserver trusts when fetching this issuer's Discovery/JWKS over TLS. Omit for a publicly-trusted issuer (Okta, Entra, Google); the system trust store is used. Required only for a self-hosted or bundled issuer whose cert does not chain to a public root, so trusting it stays config, not an apiserver trust-store change.

groupsClaim.description: Groups claim by name. Modelled per-IdP because the claim name is provider-specific (e.g. Okta's is per-app). Kubernetes exposes no groups-claim shape knob; the value is used as-is or transformed by a per-IdP CEL expression.
